title: THE LAST FAINT WORDS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): take pictures and make sure the menus actually look good. A picture and readability check of every screen after the menu builds found three last weak spots: LOST on the death card in a red too dark to read well, and PRESS ANY BUTTON on the arcade attract screen fading almost to nothing at the low end of its pulse. LOST is a lighter red now and the pulse never fades below about two thirds. Nothing else changed.
now: LOST on the death card and the arcade PRESS ANY BUTTON line are easier to read.

edits.replacement: '@keyframes attpulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.6}}';   // vNN.xx (ui5q1s): the faint end of the pulse still reads (2.8:1 at .35)
